fact_text: Foreign investors were net buyers in almost every month from Nov 2023 while local individual investors sold, a pattern the analyst linked to global market weakness.

fact_text: Foreign investors bought about 102 million in Oct 2024, one of many months of net buying in the period.

fact_text: Foreign investors sold about 72 million in Feb 2025, continuing the net selling that began in January.

fact_text: When foreigners, mutual funds, banks and insurers are all selling, retail buying alone is a weak signal, and a discounted price can still fall further.
